scope: Preflight and TRAIN pilot; the frozen design and promotion gates are unchanged.

design_issues.I0: A separate code review was requested with the actual candidate, pilot, verifier, benchmark, tests and upstream geometry/objective source. Design-only review is not treated as code approval.
design_issues.I1: Exp508 distance_contributions uses scipy.cdist Euclidean length as radius. sum_j(residual_j^2/radius)=radius, including zero contribution when radius is zero. The independent A-model identity test passes. Removing the division would change the frozen experiment and is rejected.
design_issues.I2: pilot.worker generates all validation mutations from x[held]=C. Candidate construction receives x[fit] only; B supplies ranking parents. Training and validation seeds are distinct. Existing five-fold splits are replayed.
design_issues.I3: The conditional full evaluation uses the historical retrospective TEST-label ROC frontier only after score freezing. It does not estimate an operational threshold from B or A. No full runner exists or is approved by the TRAIN gate yet; its implementation requires separate verification if eligible.
design_issues.I4: The n<32 branch performs no A-only fit or optimization and copies square_joint for both new scores. fallback and optimizer_trained explicitly record this exception; tests cover n=2 and n=31.
design_issues.I5: Roles are separated by row index, not by unique waveform content. Distinct rows with equal values may occupy different roles. This is a limitation on novelty claims, not self-reference of the same row. Deduplication or removal of zero-distance neighbors would change the frozen protocol and is not introduced.
design_issues.I6: The fixed +0.02 gate is not capped. A required recall above one is a registered failure and does not authorize threshold relaxation.
design_issues.I7: The verifier recomputes loss from stored scores, stationarity from stored gradients, and recalls/tails/gates from stored validation scores. It does not independently reconstruct contributions, geometry or full gradients. This limitation is explicit in verification output; existing finite-difference and contribution-identity tests provide separate code checks.
design_issues.I8: The inherited loader derives target length from all normal TRAIN, including F and C, before cross-fitting. Only the subsequent candidate encoder/scaler/OAS/reference fit is A-only. The protocol already discloses inherited all-normal-TRAIN preprocessing.
design_issues.I9: Full-F controls are separately fitted with the original deterministic implementation and seed. Every original control recall and tail is checked against Exp508 pilot records; tests compare independently fitted full/A controls and ranking. Historical per-query score equality is not claimed for pilot records that do not store those vectors.
design_issues.I10: The original residual-preserving shrunk OASGeometry is reused, including its tau floor and orthogonal residual. Replacing it with sample covariance or deleting null-space residuals is rejected. Constant-input checks pass.
design_issues.I11: Finite final iterates remain the preregistered estimator. Solver status, iterations, objective, projected gradient and objective-gap upper bound are recorded. No retries, iteration extensions or convergence-based model substitution are added.
design_issues.I12: Tail uses the held C score vector, NumPy linear quantiles, and the frozen package version. The original controls replay the same tail statistic. Constant inputs are tested.
design_issues.I13: This remains a repeatedly exposed development benchmark. The 50-family screening subset does not create an untouched confirmatory population. No new holdout claim or selection rule is introduced.
design_issues.I14: The original scaler, k=min(3,|A|), leave-self-out k=min(3,|A|-1), and n<32 fallback remain fixed. Boundary and constant/short-input tests pass.

acceleration_decision.reason: All three CPU paths meet score, ranking and candidate parity, but Numba speedup 0.9999297732 and Torch CPU speedup 1.0044333575 are below 1.1. Actual MLX GPU and MPS probes reject float64.
acceleration_decision.statistics_backend: NumPy reductions and quantiles; official transforms and optimizer are unchanged.

resolution.parent_cap: The verified pilot normal-TRAIN range is 40 to 353, so every B set has at most 70 parents. The pilot-only verifier's <=128 assertion is valid for this frozen population. The capped head path remains covered by the existing unit test; a conditional full evaluator would require its own verifier.
resolution.independent_split_reconstruction: The verifier intentionally reconstructs the preregistered constants and permutations independently. The actual crossfit implementation was checked against this reconstruction. Calling the same production split functions would reduce independence.
resolution.constant_fixture: The bounded 32x9 zero-input probe confirms exact unit weights, an exactly zero initial gradient and successful solver termination at iteration zero. Some synthetic scores are nonzero; the initial diagnostic assumption that all were zero was incorrect. The registered test and solver remain unchanged.
resolution.atomic_output: The verifier now uses the existing write_json_atomic_antigravity helper. A temporary-file overwrite/read-back check passed. This is the only post-review verifier change and does not change scoring or selection.

code_review.remaining_boundary: Regenerate the Exp510 code map and bind the reviewed source plus the atomic-output correction in preflight before any official pilot. No official pilot or full evaluation was started in this continuation.
